title: Bro account dimension synthesizes provider env
content: Brofile `account` names are a cross-provider dimension. Dispatch resolves provider-specific environment defaults from the brofile account name (Claude -> `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, Codex -> `CODEX_HOME`, Copilot -> `GH_CONFIG_DIR`) and then merges explicit account config overrides on top.
rationale: The prior behavior stored an `account` field on brofiles but only worked when a separate raw env override existed in bro config. That made account selection invisible and inconsistent across providers. Synthesizing provider defaults from the account name makes brofile account selection first-class while preserving explicit overrides.
